'''Echani desh gauntlets''' were an item of heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were made from the metal [[Desh/Legends|desh]] and consisted of a [[black]] glove with a [[Silver/Legends|silver]] elbow guard and control panel attached. Whether they were made by the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] species or simply named for them is unknown.
